name: Kwalasha (Unknown depths)
detailed_description:
When meteorites loaded with an unknown substance fell from the sky, the world changed forever. The Empire, absolute ruler of land and sea, tried to control its extraction. But the opportunity to get rich was too tempting. Common people, bandits, opportunists... everyone wanted their share.

In Kwalasha, you step into the shoes of a ruthless pirate captain. Your sole objective: dive into the oceanic abysses where the meteorite's ether remains intact, and loot the wreckage of submarines and imperial ships destroyed by mutant sea creatures.

But this isn't just simple looting. Each expedition is a battle against the unknown.

Features

  • Turn-based Roguelite RPG

  • Hire the most ruthless to join your crew

  • Assemble your team to dominate the depths

  • Decide what equipment to bring on each dive

  • Equip your crew with items lost by the Empire

  • Upgrade items to make them powerful

  • Create powerful combinations with the crew's various abilities

  • When a crew member dies, they become part of the abyss along with their equipment

  • Choose the best path

Turn-based Tactical Strategy

Every move counts. Manage your crew, combine abilities, and survive lethal encounters against mutated enemies. There are no easy battles: only good decisions... or permanent consequences.

Roguelite Progression

Dives are dangerous but always bring rewards. Recruit new crew members, obtain the precious ether, and fantastic loot thanks to the Empire's mistakes. Each expedition is different, and death can mean starting over... but wiser.

A Hostile and Changing World

The abysses are unforgiving. Mutant creatures, changing maps, blocked routes, moral decisions, and unexpected events will make each descent unique.

Loot, Decisions, and Betrayal

You're not a hero. You just want riches. Ether is the goal, but you can also recover imperial artifacts, trade on the black market, and become increasingly stronger by equipping your crew. The better equipped they are, the deeper you'll be able to go.

Choose Your Crew

The composition of your crew will be of utmost importance to reach the bottom of the abyss. Mix crew types with powerful items to ensure success.

Kwalasha is for those who enjoy games that punish your mistakes, reward your ingenuity, and offer always different playthroughs. If you like tense turn-based combat, equipment management, and the adrenaline of losing everything on a bad decision... the abyss awaits you.
